name_input: APP SYSTEMS(INDIA) PVT LTD; APP SYSTEMS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S APP SYSTEMS (INDIA) PVT.LTD; APP SYSTEMS(INDIA) PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for APP SYSTEMS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/app-systems-india-private-limited) shows a counter of "Total Shipments 164 Records detected", "Trading Partners 4", "Ports 6", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on the free view: 5 shipment rows. One exact export row: "2025-12-18 | APP SYSTEMS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | SRF FLEXIPAK SOUTH AFRICA PTY L | INERT- HFC POLYCOLD REFRIGERANT PART NO:940079-35- | BANGALORE ACC, India | DURBAN, S AFRICA | 28042990 | BOL 7981333". Buyer-side aggregation confirms repeat export flows: "39 M/S SRF FLEXIPAK SOUTH AFRICA PTY L", "6 M/S.ADVANCED ENERGY INDUSTRIES,INC" (Fort Collins CO, USA), "8 APP SYSTEM SERVICES PTE LTD" (Singapore). Note: declared HS 841311 (pumps for dispensing fuel/lubricants) does NOT match the observed export HS codes 28042990 (rare gases/refrigerant blends) and 84818090/85381090/85124000 on the import side — actual trade is refrigeration/vacuum/thermal-management equipment, not fuel-dispensing pumps.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403 and the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unreachable during this run, so no domestic supply record was seen. Address on record is "V K COMMERCE, NO. 8 (OLD NO. 28), 3RD MAIN ROAD, KSIDC INDUSTRIAL EST" (Karnataka) — presence of a registered industrial-estate address is not evidence of domestic supply.
note: Real cross-border shipments are documented, so this is not a paper company: exports to South Africa (SRF Flexipak, Durban, BOL 7981333, 2025-12-18) and the USA (Advanced Energy Industries) are visible, alongside imports from Singapore (APP Systems Services Pte Ltd), Germany (Pfeiffer Vacuum) and Czechia (Kablo Vrchlabi). Role is trader/manufacturer_trader — it both imports components (PCB PFC control modules, buffer valves, foam wipers) and re-exports finished refrigerant gas, which is consistent with an assembly/trading operation rather than a pure producer. Source counter vs rows seen: 164 shipments claimed, only 5 rows rendered on the free view — the 164 figure is the site's counter, not independently verified. Export HS codes observed (28042990, 84818090, 85381090, 85124000) contradict the declared 841311; per project rule 3 this is not grounds for rejection — company stays in the base with the code corrected to the factual 28042990 for the confirmed export line, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence is missing (null), not negative — it was simply not retrievable in this run, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume figures: null, not public on the free views.
